implementation: Native OINK v1.5.1 echarts fences; data embedded in both language editions. No runtime data fetch.

charts.method: Top six repositories by retained stars at cutoff; sum the remaining 40 into other. Month-end timestamps, except the final partial month uses the source as_of date. The total is the sum of all 46 repository series. Retained star history excludes unstarred events and is not a record of historical net star counts.

Use the upstream 180-day filter: publication day minus 179 days through publication day. The latest observed day is November 6. Trailing average uses complete observations in (date - 7 days, date], requires at least four observations, and is rounded to two decimals; missing averages stay null. No partial-day flags are set in this window. Like the upstream renderer, the average uses the reported aggregate daily values even when individual site bindings are missing; these coverage gaps are disclosed below the chart. Monthly metrics come from the directly queried October row in aggregate.monthly; sessions are summed over the selected daily window. Site totals are not deduplicated across sites.

coverage.scope: The coverage and tracking scope change over time. These are aggregate site counts, not a constant-site cohort.
